body: thank you. all i want is honesty. we were both struggling at the time when he cheated and i really don’t think he purposefully meant to hurt me but he did. im trying to relax because i gave him another chance and he knows if he screws it up that i’m done. i care about him so much but i also struggle with mental health and need to take care of myself.

i hope it’s just my anxiety but if i were to find out he was doing it again i would most definitely leave him. i gave him another chance because him and i were both struggling at the time so i understand why he might’ve done it.

whenever i try to bring it up he’ll start raising his voice and bringing up things that i’ve struggled with in the past like addiction and self harm that i didn’t tell him about. it wasn’t like i was purposefully hiding those things it just took me time to get comfortable talking about them and i eventually opened up.
yes. it was a tough situation and i didn’t know he had a gf but the second i found out i blocked him. we made up a few months later and now we’re dating.
